raw_definitions: Definisi : ~ in, membawa: the new reign ~ed in a period of peace and prosperity, pemerintahan baru itu membawa satu zaman keamanan dan kemakmuran. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : vt menunjuki [sso] (tempat duduk sso), menunjukkan (tempat duduk) kpd [sso]: she ~ed the guests to their seats, dia menunjuki tetamu-tetamu tempat duduk mereka; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : 2. one who regulates admittance, seating in a law court, bentara mahkamah; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : n 1. one who guides member of audience, congregation, etc to their seats, penunjuk tempat duduk; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
